title: PoSTCache: From Forecasting to Postdictive Smoothing for Revisable Diffusion Caching
title_zh: PoSTCache：从预测到后验平滑的可修正扩散缓存

paragraphs.en: Diffusion and flow matching models achieve impressive visual generation quality but remain computationally expensive due to iterative sampling. Caching-based acceleration provides a practical training-free solution by reusing or predicting intermediate features. However, existing methods largely enforce a forward-only information flow: approximations produced for skipped model evaluations are immediately committed to the sampling trajectory and cannot benefit from feedback generated by later full-computation steps. We propose PoSTCache ( Postdictive Smoothing Trajectory Cache ), a training-free and plug-and-play framework that reformulates diffusion caching as revisable trajectory inference. PoSTCache first uses an existing caching strategy to construct forward proposals for skipped steps. At a later full-computation step, the discrepancy between the refreshed prediction and its forward proposal yields a correction signal, which PoSTCache propagates backward to refine and reintegrate the preceding predictions. Viewing full-computation steps as sources of corrective feedback also changes how they should be selected. We therefore introduce the Posterior Variance Reduction (PVR) strategy, which estimates cross-timestep dependencies from offline denoising trajectories and selects anchors according to their expected reduction in surrogate trajectory uncertainty rather than local approximation error alone. Experiments on representative image and video generation models show that PoSTCache consistently improves the quality–efficiency trade-off over representative caching methods.

paragraphs.en: Traditional acceleration techniques, such as distillation ( Song et al., 2023 ) and post-training quantization ( Li et al., 2023 ) , often incur additional training costs, architectural modifications, or non-trivial deployment efforts. In contrast, caching provides a lightweight, training-free alternative by exploiting the temporal redundancy of intermediate representations ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Bu et al., 2025 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) . Existing caching approaches have evolved from static feature reuse ( Selvaraju et al., 2024 ) to adaptive strategies that estimate inter-step redundancy online ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Haghighi and Alahi, 2026 ) , extrapolate future feature trajectories with polynomial approximations ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Feng et al., 2026 ) , or exploit shallow-layer dynamics to guide deep-layer feature reuse ( Bu et al., 2025 ) . More recently, caching has also been extended beyond the original feature space to spectral representations ( Chung et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 传统的加速技术，如蒸馏（Song et al., 2023）和训练后量化（Li et al., 2023），往往会带来额外的训练成本、架构修改或非平凡的部署工作。 相比之下，缓存通过利用中间表示的时间冗余性，提供了一种轻量级、无需训练的替代方案（Liu et al., 2025a; Bu et al., 2025; Chung et al., 2026）。 现有的缓存方法已经从静态特征复用（Selvaraju et al., 2024）发展为多种自适应策略：在线估计步间冗余（Liu et al., 2025a; Ma et al., 2026; Haghighi and Alahi, 2026）、利用多项式逼近外推未来特征轨迹（Liu et al., 2025b; Feng et al., 2026），或利用浅层动力学来引导深层特征复用（Bu et al., 2025）。 最近，缓存还被扩展到了原始特征空间之外，应用于谱表示（Chung et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Despite their diversity, most existing caching methods follow a strictly forward information flow , which we refer to as forecasting : skipped-step predictions are constructed from historical information and committed to the sampling trajectory without later revision, allowing approximation errors to propagate through subsequent updates, as illustrated in Figure 1 (a). This raises a broader question: does later sampling reveal new information that could help correct these earlier errors? In particular, periodic full-computation steps produce fresh predictions after the trajectory has evolved through preceding approximations, potentially exposing backward-looking information about accumulated errors. For example, the discrepancy between a refreshed prediction and its forward proposal can provide such corrective evidence. However, most existing methods use this newly revealed information only for subsequent sampling, rather than propagating it backward to revise earlier estimates. This motivates a postdictive smoothing view of diffusion caching, inspired by Bayesian smoothing, in which later evidence retrospectively revises uncertain intermediate estimates ( Rauch et al., 1965 ; Rabiner, 1989 ; Särkkä and Svensson, 2023 ) . Accordingly, we treat skipped predictions as provisional rather than final, allowing feedback from later full-computation steps to retrospectively refine these estimates and enable backward information flow , as illustrated in Figure 1 (b).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管形式多样，现有的缓存方法大多遵循严格前向的信息流，我们将其称为预测：跳步预测由历史信息构造而成，并被提交到采样轨迹中且不再修正，这使得近似误差得以在后续更新中传播，如图 1 (a) 所示。 这引出了一个更宽泛的问题：后续的采样是否会揭示有助于纠正这些早期误差的新信息？ 特别是，周期性的全计算步骤会在轨迹经历先前若干次近似而演化之后再产生新的预测，从而可能暴露出关于累积误差的后顾信息。 例如，刷新后的预测与前向提案之间的差异即可提供这类纠错证据。 然而，现有的大多数方法仅将这些新揭示的信息用于后续采样，而不是将其反向传播以修正更早的估计。 这启发了一种受贝叶斯平滑启发的扩散缓存后验平滑视角，其中后续的证据会回溯性地修正不确定的中间估计（Rauch et al., 1965；Rabiner, 1989；Särkkä and Svensson, 2023）。 据此，我们将跳步预测视为临时的而非最终的，允许来自后续全计算步骤的反馈回溯性地精化这些估计，从而实现反向信息流，如图 1 (b) 所示。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this perspective, we propose PoSTCache, short for Postdictive Smoothing Trajectory Cache , a training-free and plug-and-play framework that reformulates cache-based acceleration as revisable trajectory inference. Building on an existing caching strategy, PoSTCache propagates feedback from subsequent full-computation anchors backward to refine skipped predictions and reintegrates the corrected trajectory. This shift also changes how anchors should be valued: from their local approximation error to their trajectory-level corrective value. We therefore introduce the Posterior Variance Reduction (PVR) strategy, which estimates cross-timestep dependencies from offline denoising trajectories and greedily selects anchors to reduce surrogate trajectory uncertainty under a fixed computation budget. Figure 1 (c) previews the resulting quality–latency trade-off.

paragraphs.en: Generative Model Acceleration. Acceleration methods for diffusion and flow-based models reduce either the cost of each model evaluation or the number of sampling steps. The former includes model compression techniques such as pruning ( Fang et al., 2023 ) , quantization ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and knowledge distillation ( Meng et al., 2023 ) , as well as computation-efficient designs such as FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ) and token reduction ( Bolya et al., 2022 ) . The latter improves sampling efficiency through deterministic sampling with DDIM ( Song et al., 2020a ) , high-order ODE solvers such as DPM-Solver ( Lu et al., 2022 ) , alternative generative dynamics including flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) and rectified flow ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , or few-step generation through progressive distillation ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ) , consistency models ( Song et al., 2023 ) , Shortcut Models ( Frans et al., 2025 ) , and MeanFlow ( Geng et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Cache-based Acceleration. Caching provides a lightweight and training-free alternative by exploiting the temporal redundancy of intermediate representations. Early methods reuse U-Net features with fixed schedules, including DeepCache ( Ma et al., 2024 ) and FasterDiffusion ( Li et al., 2024 ) , while FORA ( Selvaraju et al., 2024 ) and Δ \Delta -DiT ( Chen et al., 2024b ) extend feature or attention reuse to diffusion transformers. More recent approaches adaptively determine when to refresh cached features using different error proxies, such as TeaCache ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , MagCache ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , and DiCache ( Bu et al., 2025 ) . TaylorSeer ( Liu et al., 2025b ) and HiCache ( Feng et al., 2026 ) instead predict future features from historical states. Other methods incorporate trajectory priors, including spectral evolution in SeaCache ( Chung et al., 2026 ) , global path planning in DPCache ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , average-velocity stability in MeanCache ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , and offline residual rectification in ERTACache ( Peng et al., 2026 ) . Despite these advances, most methods remain online forward-only: skipped states are determined using historical information or offline priors and remain unrevised after future full-computation states become available.

paragraphs.en: Bayesian Posterior Smoothing. Bayesian smoothing estimates an intermediate latent state using both past and future observations, whereas filtering conditions only on observations available up to the current time. For linear Gaussian systems, this principle underlies Kalman filtering ( Kalman, 1960 ) and the Rauch–Tung–Striebel smoother ( Rauch et al., 1965 ) . A similar forward–backward inference procedure is used in hidden Markov models ( Rabiner, 1989 ) . Bayesian smoothing has been generalized to nonlinear and non-Gaussian state-space models ( Särkkä and Svensson, 2023 ) . These methods share the central idea that future evidence can retrospectively correct uncertain intermediate estimates, motivating our reformulation of diffusion caching as revisable trajectory inference.
paragraphs.zh: 贝叶斯后验平滑。 贝叶斯平滑利用过去和未来的观测来估计中间潜在状态，而滤波仅以截至当前时刻可获得的观测为条件。 对于线性高斯系统，这一原理构成了卡尔曼滤波（ Kalman, 1960 ）和 Rauch–Tung–Striebel 平滑器（ Rauch et al., 1965 ）的基础。 类似的前向–后向推断过程也被用于隐马尔可夫模型中（ Rabiner, 1989 ）。 贝叶斯平滑已被推广到非线性和非高斯状态空间模型（ Särkkä and Svensson, 2023 ）。 这些方法共享一个核心思想，即未来的证据可以在回溯中修正不确定的中间估计，这促使我们将扩散缓存重新表述为可修正的轨迹推断。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented PoSTCache, a training-free and plug-and-play framework that reformulates diffusion caching as a revisable trajectory inference problem. By using feedback from subsequent full-computation steps, PoSTCache retrospectively refines skipped predictions and reintegrates the corrected sampling trajectory. Viewing anchors as sources of corrective feedback, we further introduced a posterior variance reduction criterion to select informative anchors according to their expected reduction in surrogate trajectory uncertainty. Extensive experiments on representative image and video generation models demonstrate that PoSTCache consistently improves the efficiency–fidelity trade-off and can be readily integrated with different forward caching strategies. Currently, PoSTCache estimates a shared anchor configuration from offline trajectories and applies it uniformly to all samples. Although this design is simple and effective, it may not fully capture sample-specific trajectory dynamics. A promising direction for future work is to combine the offline uncertainty structure with lightweight online observations, enabling the anchor schedule to adapt to each sampling trajectory without introducing substantial inference overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 PoSTCache，一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，它将扩散缓存重新表述为一个可修订的轨迹推断问题。 通过利用后续完整计算步骤的反馈，PoSTCache 回溯性地修正被跳过的预测，并重新整合修正后的采样轨迹。 将锚点视为修正反馈的来源，我们进一步引入了一个后验方差缩减准则，根据锚点对替代轨迹不确定性的期望缩减程度来选择信息量大的锚点。 在代表性图像与视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，PoSTCache 持续改善了效率与保真度之间的权衡，并且可以轻松与不同的前向缓存策略集成。 目前，PoSTCache 从离线轨迹中估计一个共享的锚点配置，并将其统一应用于所有样本。 尽管这种设计简单有效，但它可能无法充分捕捉样本特定的轨迹动态。 未来工作的一个有前景的方向是将离线不确定性结构与轻量级在线观测相结合，使锚点调度能够适应每条采样轨迹，而不引入显著的推理开销。

paragraphs.en: We compare PoSTCache with representative training-free diffusion caching methods, including TeaCache ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , TaylorSeer ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , MagCache ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , DiCache ( Bu et al., 2025 ) , HiCache ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , SeaCache ( Chung et al., 2026 ) , and SenCache ( Haghighi and Alahi, 2026 ) . We use the official implementations whenever available. For each baseline, we perform a lightweight runtime calibration on a small profiling set (typically two prompts), varying only its acceleration-control parameters to identify configurations with latency closest to the corresponding Fast and Slow regimes of PoSTCache. This calibration uses latency only and does not access any generation-quality metric. The selected configurations are then fixed and evaluated on the complete benchmark using the same prompt–seed pairs as the other methods. Tables 6 and 7 report the complete configurations.

paragraphs.en: Inference latency is measured during the actual generation of the DrawBench and VBench evaluation samples rather than using isolated synthetic inputs. The reported latency is the arithmetic mean over all evaluated prompts and random seeds for each model and method under the same hardware and software environment. Output serialization and metric computation are excluded from the timing.

paragraphs.en: FLOPs and GPU memory are profiled over the generation loop. FLOPs are estimated using torch.profiler with FLOP counting enabled, and the estimates reported by all supported ATen operators are summed. The profiler primarily provides FLOP metadata for matrix multiplication and convolution; therefore, the reported FLOPs do not necessarily include every element-wise or framework-level operation. Before each profiled generation, we synchronize the GPU and reset the CUDA peak-memory statistics. Peak memory is reported as the maximum allocated CUDA memory obtained from torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() , expressed in GiB. We report allocated rather than reserved memory to reflect the peak memory actively used by tensors during inference.
paragraphs.zh: FLOPs 和 GPU 显存是在生成循环过程中进行测量的。 FLOPs 使用 torch.profiler 并启用 FLOP 计数来估计，并将所有受支持的 ATen 算子报告的估计值求和。 该分析器主要提供矩阵乘法和卷积的 FLOP 元数据；因此，所报告的 FLOPs 不一定包含每个逐元素操作或框架层面的操作。 在每次被测量的生成之前，我们会同步 GPU 并重置 CUDA 峰值显存统计。 峰值显存报告为从 torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() 获得的最大已分配 CUDA 显存，以 GiB 表示。 我们报告已分配显存而非已保留显存，以反映推理期间张量实际使用的峰值显存。

paragraphs.en: To complement the quantitative trajectory analysis in Sec. 3.2 , we visualize the denoising trajectories of full inference, forward-only caching, and PoSTCache in a low-dimensional space. As shown in Figure 5 , forward-only caching progressively deviates from the full-inference trajectory, whereas postdictive smoothing consistently pulls the trajectory toward the full-inference reference after future anchors become available. This behavior is observed across both image and video generation models.

paragraphs.en: PoSTCache estimates its cross-timestep dependency profile from a small set of offline denoising trajectories and uses the resulting PVR schedule for subsequent inference. paragraphs.en: Overall, the source PVR schedule remains a robust practical default across the evaluated prompt, guidance, and spatial shifts. paragraphs.en: To isolate the scheduling objective, we adapt DPCache to the same PoSTCache online pipeline. DPCache-Pre follows the original pre-correction principle and constructs its path cost from nearest-reuse proposal errors before postdictive smoothing. paragraphs.en: A small discrepancy after a single numerical update does not necessarily imply negligible end-to-end impact, since diffusion sampling recursively feeds each updated latent state into subsequent model evaluations. paragraphs.en: Figure 9 compares PoSTCache with representative caching methods on OpenSora 1.2. paragraphs.en: Overall, the qualitative results are consistent with the reconstruction metrics reported in the main paper. By revising skipped predictions using future-anchor evidence, PoSTCache reduces accumulated errors in local texture, object geometry, spatial composition, and temporal appearance across different image and video generation architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，定性结果与正文报告的重建指标一致。 通过利用未来锚点证据修正被跳过的预测，PoSTCache 减少了不同图像与视频生成架构中局部纹理、物体几何、空间构成以及时序外观方面的累积误差。

sents.en: By revising skipped predictions using future-anchor evidence, PoSTCache reduces accumulated errors in local texture, object geometry, spatial composition, and temporal appearance across different image and video generation architectures.

paragraphs.en: PoSTCache relies on offline trajectory statistics to construct a shared anchor schedule. The resulting schedule transfers well across the evaluated prompt distributions, guidance scales, and spatial configurations, but this does not imply that the underlying dependency profile is invariant or that a single schedule is optimal for every sample. Target-specific reprofiling can improve the offline PVR objective or the held-out prediction-space error without improving the final reconstruction. This discrepancy reflects an offline–online gap: the offline profile is estimated on stored full-computation trajectories, whereas online correction changes the latent states and recursively affects subsequent model predictions. In addition, the current greedy selector is path dependent; small finite-sample perturbations of otherwise similar covariance profiles can alter early anchor choices and produce substantially different schedules. Combining the shared offline prior with inexpensive online trajectory observations is therefore a promising direction for more stable and sample-adaptive anchor selection.
paragraphs.zh: PoSTCache 依赖离线轨迹统计来构建共享的锚点调度。 所得到的调度在所评估的提示分布、引导尺度和空间配置之间具有良好的迁移性，但这并不意味着底层的依赖特性是不变的，也不意味着单一调度对每个样本都是最优的。 针对特定目标重新剖面可以在离线 PVR 目标或留出预测空间误差上有所改进，却不一定能改善最终的重构结果。 这一差异反映了离线与在线之间的鸿沟：离线剖面是在存储的完整计算轨迹上估计的，而在线修正会改变潜在状态并递归地影响后续的模型预测。 此外，当前的贪心选择器具有路径依赖性；对原本相似的协方差剖面施加微小的有限样本扰动，就可能改变早期的锚点选择并产生差异显著的调度。 因此，将共享的离线先验与低成本的在线轨迹观测相结合，是实现更稳定、更适应样本的锚点选择的一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: Retrospective reintegration can also introduce a local state–prediction mismatch at future anchors. Appendix C.6 shows that unconditional anchor refresh reduces this mismatch but is less compute-efficient than broader anchor coverage in our matched-NFE comparison. Our analysis nevertheless compares only two coarse allocation strategies and does not exclude more selective policies. An adaptive scheme that refreshes only high-risk anchors, or dynamically allocates each additional model evaluation between anchor refresh and new anchor placement, may yield a more favorable consistency–coverage trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 回溯性重整合还可能在未来的锚点上引入局部状态—预测失配。 附录 C.6 表明，在我们匹配 NFE 的比较中，无条件的锚点刷新可以减少这种失配，但计算效率低于更广的锚点覆盖。 然而，我们的分析只比较了两种粗粒度的分配策略，并不排除更具选择性的策略。 一种只刷新高风险锚点的自适应方案，或者在锚点刷新与新锚点放置之间动态分配每次额外模型评估的自适应方案，可能带来更有利的一致性—覆盖权衡。

paragraphs.en: Postdictive correction further relies on the temporal correlation between skipped prediction errors and innovations revealed by future anchors. Our implementation approximates the full covariance-dependent smoothing gain with an isotropic linear gain determined by sampling progress. Although this approximation is effective in the evaluated regimes, it cannot fully capture nonlinear, feature-dependent, or sample-specific error evolution. Under very aggressive acceleration or unusually long cache intervals, accumulated drift may weaken the relationship between a future innovation and earlier skipped predictions, limiting the recoverable error.
paragraphs.zh: 后向修正进一步依赖于被跳过的预测误差与由未来锚点揭示的新息之间的时间相关性。 我们的实现用一个由采样进度确定的各向同性线性增益来近似完全依赖协方差的平滑增益。 尽管这一近似在所评估的场景中是有效的，但它无法完全捕捉非线性的、依赖于特征的或样本特定的误差演化。 在非常激进加速或异常长的缓存间隔下，累积漂移可能削弱未来新息与早前被跳过预测之间的关系，从而限制可恢复的误差。
